程序启动时默认使用哪个工具（默认是 PowerShell）。运行时可以随时用标题: Which tool is used by default when the app starts (PowerShell by default). You can switch at any time with the toggle in the title bar: Ctrl+1 for CMD, Ctrl+2 for PowerShell; you can also prefix a single command with cmd> / ps>.
输出编码默认为自动识别：逐行尝试 UTF-8，失败则回退到系统 OEM 代码页（: Output encoding defaults to Auto-detect: each line is tried as UTF-8 first and falls back to the system OEM code page (GBK on Chinese systems). If a tool still shows garbled text, set the encoding manually in Settings.
在程序目录的 commands 子目录里放入符合格式的 JSON 文件，重启后即: Drop correctly formatted JSON files into the commands subfolder of the app directory and restart to extend or override the command library. The built-in command library is already packaged inside the exe.
工具箱默认以普通权限启动。需要管理员的命令会在标题栏和确认框里提示，点标题栏的「: The app starts without elevation by default. Commands that need administrator privileges are flagged in the title bar and in the confirmation dialog; click "Restart as administrator" in the title bar to relaunch elevated (a system UAC prompt appears).
命令输出可能是 GBK（中文系统默认）也可能是 UTF-8（git / pyth: Command output may be GBK (the default on Chinese systems) or UTF-8 (git / python, etc.). Auto mode checks each line, so garbled text is rare.
cd / pushd / popd 由工具箱自己维护，切换目录后下一条命令仍在该: cd / pushd / popd are handled by the app itself: after you change directory the next command still runs there, and the status bar shows the current path live.
4. 参数会按当前输入的层级变化：例如 netsh → wlan → show: 4. Suggestions change with the level you are typing at: netsh → wlan → show → profiles is prompted step by step.
未安装 pwsh，勾选后会自动回退到系统自带的 Windows PowerShe: pwsh is not installed; when enabled this falls back to the Windows PowerShell 5.1 that ships with Windows.
在 CMD 里跑了 PowerShell 命令（或反过来）失败时，提示这是另一个: When a PowerShell command fails in CMD (or vice versa), note that it belongs to the other tool
下次启动时会弹出 UAC 请求提权；如果点了「否」，程序仍会以普通权限继续运行。: The next launch will ask for elevation with a UAC prompt; if you click "No", the app keeps running without elevation.
这一个滑块控制全界面：窗口、面板、按钮、输入框、徽标、复选框都会一起变，: This one slider drives the whole interface: windows, panels, buttons, input boxes, badges and checkboxes all change together,
1. 在左侧命令库里点一条命令，右侧会显示它的用途和可填写的参数表单。: 1. Click a command in the command library on the left; the right side shows what it does and a form for its parameters.
程序默认以普通权限启动，需要管理员的命令会单独提示并支持一键提权重启。: By default the app runs without elevation. Commands that need administrator privileges are flagged and offer a one-click elevated restart.
当前是普通权限。需要管理员的命令仍会单独提示，可以随时一键提权重启。: Currently running without elevation. Commands that need administrator privileges are still flagged, and you can restart elevated in one click at any time.
执行高危命令（格式化 / 删除 / 关机 / 改引导等）前弹出确认框: Show a confirmation dialog before high-risk commands (format / delete / shutdown / boot changes, etc.)
2. 在命令行里输入命令名，敲空格之后会自动提示下一个可用的参数。: 2. Type a command name on the command line; after you press space, the next available parameters are suggested.

未选择图片。选择后可以单独调节图片的浓淡，和面板不透明度互不影响。: No image selected. Once you choose one, you can adjust how strong it looks, independently of panel opacity.
执行会改动系统的命令（注册表 / 服务 / 权限等）前也弹确认框: Also confirm before commands that modify the system (registry / services / permissions, etc.)
